title: How the Declaration of Independence Came Together
learningObjectives: Put the main steps of drafting, adopting, printing and signing the Declaration of Independence in order
Explain why adoption on July 4 and signing on August 2 were separate events

explanations.text: Congress adopted the Declaration first; most delegates signed the engrossed parchment copy almost a month later.

evidence.quote: The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776.
on August 2, 1776, delegates began signing it.
